exchanges: hiya, just back frm the garden
Welcome back. How did it go today?
good, omer had us harvesting the last of the squash
A good harvest to end the season. Is Omer the one who runs things?
yep hes the coordinator. wore his Galatasaray scarf all day, hes obssessed with them, thinks theyll win evrything
A loyal fan, it sounds like.
lol very. i brought my dog Biscuit along, he loves the compost pile way too much
Dogs do love a good smell. What kind of dog is he?
a beagle, nose first into evrything
That fits the breed perfectly.
my friend nkechi came to help too, i made samosas for evryone, theyre my favrite thing to cook and eat
That was generous. Did they go over well?
mostly. nkechi couldnt have the shrimp ones, she's allergic, so i saved her the potato ones
Good thinking to have options.
teacher brain, always plan for allergies lol
Years of class snacks will do that.
my granddaughter leilani is home this weekend from Humber, shes doing the culinary program
How is she liking it?
loves it, wants to open a restrant someday
That is a big dream, good for her.
and my grand-niece mahina just started at Seneca, so two of them in college now
The family is full of students right now.
makes me feel old
Proud more than old, I would hope.
true. i started a watercolour class at the library, its on Tuesday afternoons
That sounds relaxing. How do you like painting?
im terrible but its fun
Fun is the main thing.
my neighbour beatriz is retiring finally, her party is in April
Retirement parties are such good celebrations.
she taught at the high school down the road, we used to carpool
That is a long friendship.
oh wait the class isnt tuesday anymore, they moved it to Thursday this month
Thanks, good to have that straight.
better for me anyway, tuesdays are busy
It works out then.
Biscuit is begging for dinner now
Beagles never forget a meal time.
haha nope
Is he on a schedule?
6 sharp every night
Very punctual.
my brother callum phoned, his foot is swollen up again, the doctor says its gout
That sounds painful. Is he taking something for it?
he has pills but he wont stop eating red meat
Changing his diet would help him a lot.
whats the name of leilanis college again
